title: The adventures of lone wolf scientific
summary: The Adventures of Lone Wolf Scientific is an episodic comic series distributed electronically through bulletin board systems in the early 1990s. It follows the misadventures of a startup-minded pair of high-technology eccentrics: S-max, a hardware engineer with wild inventions and a chaotic career history, and Andrew.BAS, a soft-spoken programmer who names his software after Apollo missions. Their stories satirize the computer industry, defense contracting, and the self-importance of executives, politicians and technology pundits. Recurring figures include the magazine columnist Ordin Babblebin and the politician Congressman Boris Q. Popinrath. The installments shown here are numbered episodes, each a short comic vignette. Early episodes cover S-max losing jobs after escapades involving a four-million-watt power supply and a Rubik's Cube career, while later ones depict a defense weapons demonstration full of misfiring smart bombs and a coin-operated operating system. The work is broad, slapstick and loaded with wordplay and exaggerated jargon, and it was written as a serial with each installment ending on a teaser for the next.
